meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: Deterministic unit-impulse response. Output length is horizonDays + 1 because index 0 is the impulse itself.
notes: Pure multiply-add: `next = phi * curr + theta * (curr - prev)`. Left-to-right, no FMA. 5000 steps of pure f64 arithmetic is a strong compounding test with NO transcendentals — if this diverges, the arithmetic itself differs.
horizonDays <= 0 returns exactly [1]; the loop never runs.
phi = 1, theta = 0 is the unit-root case: every entry stays exactly 1, which is a useful exactness canary.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
